b110_identity.reason: B1.10 reconstructs B0 plus qualified patches whose target list does not include functions.f90 or irrigation.f90, so these two source members retain their exact B0 bytes.

semantics: x <= first x returns first y
inside a populated interval, linear interpolation uses the bracketing x,y pair
a decreasing next x is treated as the legacy partial-table sentinel and returns the preceding y
when the declared table is fully populated and x exceeds the last x, the last y is returned
hazards: the interpolation denominator is the difference between adjacent x knots, so duplicate bracketing x values are invalid
TCS7 and DCS2 call AFGEN with declared length 14 even when fewer than seven x,y pairs were read
the saved 14-element irrigation tables are not explicitly cleared before partial refill

restricted_target_contract.tcs7_x_range: DVS knots within legacy [0,2] input range
restricted_target_contract.dcs2_x_range: DVS knots within legacy [0,2] input range
restricted_target_contract.evaluation: for a partial table, runtime DVS must not exceed the last supplied knot; values below the first knot retain AFGEN first-y clamping
restricted_target_contract.implementation_form: explicit knot-count table, not an uninitialized 14-element sentinel buffer

ttutil_partial_table_evidence.finding: RDADOR asks RDDATA for an unknown number of values up to the declared capacity and returns that count; it does not define the unused tail of the caller array. This makes the clean target contract use an explicit actual knot count rather than preserving stale SAVE-array tail state.

tcs7.source_equation: phcrit = afgen(hcritab,14,dvs); trigger when h(nodsen) <= phcrit
tcs7.sensor_translation: legacy maps dcrit to nodsen using zbotcp and +1e-5 cm; target receives a pretranslated immutable sensor node and validates 1..active_nodes
tcs7.hydraulic_dependency: pressure_head(sensor_node) from the committed process hydraulic view

dcs2.adapter_translation: target immutable DCS2 table stores depth in cm after legacy mm-to-cm translation; the process interpolates the translated cm table

outer_scheduled_gate.precedence: fixed event selection occurs first; scheduled selection requires irrigevent == 0

legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.finding: legacy executes root-zone capacity and watcon calculations for every tcs>1, including TCS7, even though TCS7+DCS2 does not consume awlh, awmh, awah or cdef
legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.target_decision: do not migrate these calculations into the restricted TCS7+DCS2 process seam; they belong to TCS2/TCS3/TCS4/TCS6/DCS1 dependency paths
legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.qualification_limit: this is a structural dependency cut, not yet a claim of full-runtime numerical identity; later independent F-VQ must detect any observable legacy side effect before scientific admission

scheduled_ssdi.unit_translation: legacy irr_rate input mm/h is translated outside the target process to cm/d
scheduled_ssdi.multi_node_finding: scheduled SSDI does not divide DCS2 irr_depth by the number of SSDI nodes before assigning the same rate to every node
scheduled_ssdi.contrast_with_fixed_event: fixed-event SSDI explicitly divides irdepth by node count at SWAP/irrigation.f90:725-727 before cm conversion
scheduled_ssdi.restricted_target_contract: first structural seam admits only single-node SSDI, ssdi_first_node == ssdi_last_node

mass_scope.single_node_expected_external_inflow: irr_rate * active_duration, with full-event amount equal to irr_depth
